listeningStage2Data.sentence: Please knock on the door before you _______ the room.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 祈使句動詞原形，表示「進入」房間。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 在你進入房間之前請先敲門。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: The sun will _______ in the east and go down in the west.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 助動詞 will 後面接原形動詞，指太陽「升起、上升」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 太陽會從東方升起並在西方落下。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: If you work hard every day, you will _______ in the future.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 條件句與未來式搭配，表示在未來會「成功」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 如果你每天努力，你未來一定會成功。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: The little boy is very _______ and likes to play tricks on his sister.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 形容詞修飾人的個性，表示「頑皮的」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 那個小男孩非常頑皮，喜歡捉弄他的妹妹。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Don't be _______; you should learn to share your toys with friends.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 否定祈使句接形容詞，表示不要太「自私的」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 不要自私；你應該學會跟朋友分享你的玩具。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Mr. Lin gave a _______ speech because everyone was hungry.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 形容詞修飾名詞 speech，表示「簡短的」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 林先生做了一場簡短的演講，因為大家都餓了。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: The cold air made the sick child _______ loudly all night.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 使役動詞 made 接原形動詞，表示「咳嗽」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 寒冷的空氣讓生病的孩子整晚大聲咳嗽。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Every _______ on the train must show their ticket to the guard.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 單數名詞表示火車上的「乘客」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 火車上的每位乘客都必須出示車票給站務員。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: She won the first _______ in the English speaking contest.
listeningStage2Data.hint: 名詞與 first 搭配，表示贏得第一名「獎項」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 她在英語演講比賽中贏得第一名大獎。

listeningStage2Data.sentence: Our teacher is so _______ that his stories always make us laugh.
listeningStage2Data.hint: so...that...句型，形容詞表示「幽默的」。
listeningStage2Data.translation: 我們的老師非常幽默，他的故事總是逗得我們哈哈大笑。

listeningStage3Data.title: A Funny Train Trip (有趣的火車之旅)

articleContent.en: Yesterday afternoon, Tom became a passenger on a modern train to Taipei.
articleContent.zh: 昨天下午，湯姆成為搭乘開往台北的現代化火車的乘客。

articleContent.en: He wanted to enter the dining car to buy some snacks and drinks.
articleContent.zh: 他想要進入餐車買一些點心和飲料。

articleContent.en: A naughty cat suddenly jumped out of a bag.
articleContent.zh: 一隻頑皮的貓突然從袋子裡跳了出來。

articleContent.en: The friendly train conductor told a brief and humorous joke to calm everyone down.
articleContent.zh: 親切的列車長講了一個簡短又幽默的笑話讓大家平靜下來。

articleContent.en: As the sun began to set, they arrived safely at the final station.
articleContent.zh: 隨著太陽開始落下，他們安全抵達了終點站。

questions.question: Who became a passenger on the train?
What did Tom want to do on the train?
options: Enter the dining car to buy snacks
questions.correct: Enter the dining car to buy snacks

questions.question: When did Tom take this modern train?
Where were the passengers traveling to?
What suddenly jumped out of a bag?
Why did the conductor tell a brief joke?

listeningStage3Data.title: The School Art Contest (學校美術比賽)

articleContent.en: Last Friday, Lisa worked hard in the art classroom because she wanted to succeed.
articleContent.zh: 上週五，麗莎在美術教室努力創作，因為她想要成功。

articleContent.en: She painted a lovely picture of the sun beginning to rise over the ocean.
articleContent.zh: 她畫了一幅太陽開始從海面上升起的美麗圖畫。

articleContent.en: Her classmate had a sudden cough, but Lisa kindly shared some warm water with him.
articleContent.zh: 她的同學突然咳嗽，但麗莎很親切地和他分享了溫水。

articleContent.en: She was never selfish with her high quality paints and colorful brushes.
articleContent.zh: 她對於自己高品質的顏料與彩色畫筆從不自私。

articleContent.en: In the end, the exciting result was that Lisa won the first prize.
articleContent.zh: 最後，令人興奮的結果是麗莎贏得了一等獎。

questions.question: Who worked hard in the classroom to succeed?
What kind of painting did Lisa create?
options: A picture of the sun beginning to rise
A picture of a modern train
A brief portrait of a cat
questions.correct: A picture of the sun beginning to rise

questions.question: When was the exciting contest held?
Where did Lisa paint her beautiful picture?
What thing of high quality did Lisa share with others?
Why did Lisa feel very happy in the end?
options: Because she won the first prize
Because she got a higher income
questions.correct: Because she won the first prize

listeningStage3Data.title: A Good Job Choice (一份好的工作選擇)

articleContent.en: Mr. Brown went to a modern company yesterday for a job interview.
articleContent.zh: 布朗先生昨天去了一家現代化公司進行求職面試。

articleContent.en: The manager asked him to enter the bright office and give a brief self-introduction.
articleContent.zh: 經理請他進入明亮的辦公室並做簡短的自我介紹。

articleContent.en: Mr. Brown shared humorous stories about how he helped a team succeed in sales.
articleContent.zh: 布朗先生分享了幽默的故事，說明他如何協助團隊在銷售上獲得成功。

articleContent.en: He explained that product quality is more important than just earning a high income.
articleContent.zh: 他解釋說產品品質比單純賺取高收入更重要。

articleContent.en: The manager loved his honesty and immediately offered him the special prize of the position.
articleContent.zh: 經理非常喜歡他的真誠，並立刻給了他這個特別職位的錄取機會。

questions.question: Who went to the modern company for an interview?
What did Mr. Brown do in the bright office?
When did this job interview take place?
Where did the interview take place?
What thing did Mr. Brown value more than just high income?
Why did the manager offer Mr. Brown the job immediately?
options: Because he loved his honesty and humorous stories
Because Mr. Brown started to cough
questions.correct: Because he loved his honesty and humorous stories

One afternoon, a little boy started to {{3}} because of the freezing wind. The giant felt sorry and opened his garden gates to let all children {{4}} freely. The warm spring returned at once.

articleContent.en: A giant had a lovely garden, but he was too selfish to let children play inside.
articleContent.zh: 一個巨人擁有一座可愛的花園，但他太自私了而不讓孩子們進去玩耍。

articleContent.en: The cold winter stayed, and the warm sun refused to rise in spring.
articleContent.zh: 寒冬持續停留，溫暖的太陽在春天裡也拒絕升起。

articleContent.en: One afternoon, a little boy started to cough because of the freezing wind.
articleContent.zh: 某天下午，一個小男孩因為刺骨的寒風開始咳嗽。

articleContent.en: The giant felt sorry and opened his garden gates to let all children enter freely.
articleContent.zh: 巨人感到十分愧疚，便打開了花園大門讓所有孩子自由進入。

articleContent.en: The warm spring returned at once.
articleContent.zh: 溫暖的春天立刻又回來了。

questions.question: Who owned the beautiful garden at the beginning?
What happened to the garden during the cold winter?
When did a little boy start coughing in the garden?
Where were the children not allowed to enter at first?
What kind of sound did the freezing boy make in the cold?
Why did the warm spring finally return to the garden?
options: Because the giant opened the gate
Because the sun began to set
questions.correct: Because the giant opened the gate

readingStage3Data.title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf (放羊的孩子)

articleContent.en: A bored shepherd boy was very naughty and wanted to play tricks on the villagers.
articleContent.zh: 一個無聊的牧童非常頑皮，想對村民惡作劇。

articleContent.en: He gave a brief yell and shouted that a big wolf was coming.
articleContent.zh: 他發出簡短的呼喊，大喊著大野狼來了。

articleContent.en: When a real wolf truly appeared, the terrified boy could only cry in fear.
articleContent.zh: 當一隻真正的狼真的出現時，嚇壞的男孩只能在恐懼中哭泣。

articleContent.en: In the end, his bad plan did not succeed, and no one came to help him.
articleContent.zh: 最後，他的壞計畫沒有成功，而且沒有人來幫他。

questions.question: Who wanted to play tricks on the villagers?
What did the boy shout to trick the villagers?
options: He shouted that a big wolf was coming
He said he won the first prize
He invited everyone to a party
questions.correct: He shouted that a big wolf was coming

questions.question: When did the boy shout for help again?
options: When a real wolf truly appeared
After the sun began to set
questions.correct: When a real wolf truly appeared

questions.question: Where was the boy guarding the sheep?
What kind of yell did the boy give at first?
Why did nobody come to save the sheep in the end?
options: Because the villagers no longer believed the boy
questions.correct: Because the villagers no longer believed the boy

readingStage3Data.title: The North Wind and the Sun (北風與太陽)

articleContent.en: The North Wind and the Sun argued about their strength and made a humorous joke about it.
articleContent.zh: 北風和太陽爭論著彼此的力量，並為此開了一個幽默的玩笑。

articleContent.en: They agreed that the one who made a traveler remove his coat would win the prize.
articleContent.zh: 他們同意誰能讓旅行者脫掉外套就能贏得獎勵。

articleContent.en: As the sun began to set, it shone warm rays over the road.
articleContent.zh: 當太陽開始落下時，它朝著道路照射出溫暖的光芒。

articleContent.en: The final result proved that gentleness is always stronger than force.
articleContent.zh: 最終的結果證明了溫和總是勝過強硬的力量。

questions.question: Who had an argument about their personal power?
options: The North Wind and the Sun
The East Wind and the Moon
The South Wind and the Star
questions.correct: The North Wind and the Sun

questions.question: What did they challenge each other to do?
options: Make a traveler take off his heavy coat
Build a high quality modern building
Run a race across the ocean
questions.correct: Make a traveler take off his heavy coat

questions.question: When did the sun shine its gentle rays on the traveler?
options: As the sun began to set
As the sun began to rise
As the moon began to rise
questions.correct: As the sun began to set

questions.question: Where did the traveler walk along during the contest?
What did the Sun win?
Why did the traveler take off his coat in the end?
options: Because he wanted to go swimming
